scope: Validation-only candidate recommendation per split; no deployment approval or GVHD attestation
checkpoint_selection_within_run: Minimum validation CE, exact tie earliest epoch, as user-confirmed protocol
lambda_selection_within_split: Smallest arithmetic mean validation CE of the three independently selected seed checkpoints
candidate_payload: Chosen lambda per split with all three seed checkpoints; no seed chosen by best metric
variation: Sample standard deviation across seeds (ddof=1); not independent patient-cohort uncertainty
test_policy: No test data may influence this choice. Candidate lock must record config/data/source/checkpoint hashes before any final test evaluation. No return to tuning from final test.
